issue_title: BUG: Unwarranted warning when reading a file with multiple layers and using a GeoDataFrame, GeoSeries as mask or bbox option
issue_body:
- [x] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.

- [x] I have confirmed this bug exists on the latest version of geopandas.

- [x] (optional) I have confirmed this bug exists on the main branch of geopandas.

---

#### Code Sample, a copy-pastable example

```python
import os
import tempfile

import geopandas as gpd
from shapely.geometry import Point

data1 = {"geometry": [Point(1, 2), Point(2, 1)]}
gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame(data1, crs="EPSG:4326")

tmpfile_path = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".gpkg")
gdf.to_file(tmpfile_path, layer="layer1", driver="GPKG")
gdf.to_file(tmpfile_path, layer="layer2", driver="GPKG")

# This will raise an unwarranted warning:
result = gpd.read_file(tmpfile_path, bbox=gdf, layer="layer1")

if os.path.exists(tmpfile_path):
    os.remove(tmpfile_path)

```

#### Problem description

When reading a file with multiple layers, while providing the layer parameter, a warning saying "Specify the layer parameter" will still be issued if a GeoDataFrame or GeoSeries is provided as the bbox or the mask argument.

#### Expected Output
No warning should be shown if the layer is passed as an argument.
